html:
Gajah Mada was the chief minister and general of the Javanese empire of Majapahit in the middle 1300s. He led it to the height of its power, and modern Indonesia honours him as a hero of national unity.

He rose as a guard officer who saved the king during a revolt in 1319, then became prime minister around 1334 under Queen Tribhuwana. On taking office, the Javanese texts say, he swore the Palapa oath: he would not enjoy palapa, a spice or a pleasure, until he had brought all the islands of Nusantara under Majapahit. Over the next decades Majapahit sent fleets that won tribute from Bali, parts of Sumatra, Borneo and beyond.

He kept his office under the young king Hayam Wuruk. In 1357 he forced a clash at Bubat in which the king of Sunda and his court, who had come to marry a princess to Hayam Wuruk, were killed. This brought him into disgrace. He died around 1364. The poem Nagarakretagama, written the next year, is a key source on his time.
sum: Gajah Mada was the chief minister and general of the Javanese empire of Majapahit in the middle 1300s. He led it to the height of its power, and modern Indonesia honours him as a hero of national unity.
